purpose: Bind current expectations to the user-directed system jobs, completion truth, and lane isolation required for tomorrow's work.

completion_expectations.requirement: PROSE is the only system currently complete.
SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain incomplete regardless of completed packets, tests, phases or subsystem evidence.
A system becomes complete only through explicit product-level completion authority; no chat, branch, workflow or phase may infer it.

job_expectations.requirement: Integrate CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS into the System Master product without taking their product semantics.
Finish shared Foundation/Spine and integration primitives only; do not take Learning, Book, Prose or Documents product ownership.
Finish Learning and integrate it upward into System Master; do not cross into Book, Prose or Documents product work.

Finish Book, including bringing the completed Prose child in through adapters and the Book Workflow Orchestrator, then integrate Book upward into System Master while retaining canonical Book authority.

Remain the completed literary specialist beneath Book; participate only in Book-controlled integration/adapter/orchestration and demonstrated defect repair, never as an independent peer lane or canonical writer.
Finish Documents and integrate it upward into System Master for document/artifact mechanics; do not absorb Prose or take Book/Learning/Core semantics.
Remain a Core-administered support program for asset/custody/provenance recovery, not a peer system and not a product-priority override.

lane_expectations.requirement: The only direct specialist cross-lane relationship is BOOK <-> PROSE because Prose is Book's child specialist.
CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain peer owner lanes. Their integration is upward through System Master/shared interfaces and never transfers ownership.
Documents may provide document/artifact services to Book but may not absorb or own Prose literary intelligence or mutate Book canonical state.
Second Shift, repair routing, obligations, startup and current-state reconciliation must fail closed on job/lane violations.

carried_forward_expectations: All non-conflicting expectations from EXPECTATION-REGISTRY-003 remain historical/current guidance; this registry controls when there is a conflict about completion, program job, or lane ownership.
change_rule: Changing a system job, completion standing, parent/child relation or cross-lane exception requires explicit user direction and a successor current registry/lock.
